hypothesis_statement: Historical whole-tile DC offset alone degrades classification performance
measured_evidence: Condition C1_historical_dc_offset produces delta Macro-F1 = +0.3043 in S0 (95% CI: [0.2581, 0.3530], exact McNemar p < 1e-15, B=25,000 paired cluster resamples) with 0 tumour/margin pixels altered.
scientific_caveat: Shifts the entire 16x16 patch mean rather than boundary edges alone; demonstrates CNN filter fragility under spatial DC shifts.

hypothesis_statement: Pure 2-pixel tile boundary step edge noise alone degrades classification performance
measured_evidence: Condition C1_true_seam_w2 produces delta Macro-F1 = +0.1206 in S0 (95% CI: [0.0827, 0.1607], exact McNemar p < 1e-15; Macro-F1 drops from 0.9333 to 0.8127) while strictly preserving 81.35% of image pixels and 100% of tumour core/margin.
scientific_caveat: Demonstrates CNN filter sensitivity to synthetic grid step discontinuities alone. Accounts for an empirical ratio of 28.6% of the raw scrambling degradation (delta = 0.1206 / 0.4215).

hypothesis_statement: Amplified seam adjustments (gain 1.8; legacy identifier w3, same two-pixel width) produce a dose-dependent performance decline
measured_evidence: Condition C1_true_seam_w3 (legacy identifier; gain 1.8, same two-pixel width) produces delta Macro-F1 = +0.1522 in S0 (95% CI: [0.1182, 0.1904]; Macro-F1 drops to 0.7811), +0.0990 in S1 (Macro-F1 0.8341), and +0.0693 in S2 (Macro-F1 0.8580).
scientific_caveat: The S0 marginal-drop ratio is about 36.1% (0.1522 / 0.4215); it is descriptive and not an additive causal attribution.

hypothesis_statement: Distant-context spatial scrambling degrades classification performance
measured_evidence: Condition C3_c5lp_scramble produces delta Macro-F1 = +0.4215 in S0 (95% CI: [0.3722, 0.4713], exact McNemar p < 1e-15; Macro-F1 drops to 0.5118), replicating historical benchmark.
scientific_caveat: Confounded in raw form by simultaneous tile-seam edge spikes and high-frequency Fourier spectral inflation.

hypothesis_statement: Synthetic seam edge artifacts alone explain the entire scrambling performance decline (H0)
measured_evidence: C3_c5lp_scramble vs the gain-1.0 seam-only control has a Macro-F1 contrast of +0.3009 in S0 (95% CI: [0.2506, 0.3496]). The locally blended C2 permutation condition has a C0-to-C2 contrast of +0.4808 (95% CI: [0.4360, 0.5280]). The difference between these conditions is descriptive; the controls are not energy-matched and C2 attenuation diagnostics remain pending.
scientific_caveat: Supports the view that the gain-1.0 seam-only perturbation does not reproduce the full observed C3 decline, but the non-matched controls do not identify a causal allocation between seam and spatial effects.

hypothesis_statement: Macroscopic spatial layout can be isolated as an independent causal coordinate variable
measured_evidence: The previously published C2 attenuation values are withdrawn because its diagnostic generator used a different operator than the one used for evaluation. The corrected diagnostic script must be run before C2 attenuation can be quantified; C2 performance under the evaluated locally blended permutation remains 0.4525 Macro-F1 in S0.
scientific_caveat: Spatial scrambling inherently conflates four inseparable factors: (1) altered anatomical layout, (2) non-local tissue juxtapositions (e.g. skull bone adjacent to ventricular CSF), (3) residual boundary steps, and (4) out-of-distribution (OOD) topological inputs.

hypothesis_statement: Models rely on continuous stereotactic cranial coordinate mappings rather than categorical spatial priors
measured_evidence: Across 1,426 true glioma slices in S0, misclassification into the skull-base pituitary class follows a monotonic disorientation gradient: 0.14% in C0 baseline, 16.48% in C1_true_seam_w2, 23.35% in C1_true_seam_w3, 31.28% in C1_historical_dc_offset, 56.45% in C3_c5lp_scramble, and 63.53% in C2_seam_suppressed.
scientific_caveat: Confirms categorical disorientation and collapse into the model default suprasellar/skull-base prediction mode under unnatural tissue juxtapositions; does NOT prove continuous stereotactic coordinate mapping.

hypothesis_statement: The observed contextual reliance and seam fragility generalize across model families and clinical cohorts
measured_evidence: Validated across 15 ResNet-50 checkpoints on 3,064 Figshare slices across three split regimes (S0, S1, S2).
scientific_caveat: Has not been evaluated on modern Vision Transformers, ConvNeXt, or external multi-center clinical cohorts (TCGA, BraTS); external generalization remains an open question.

hypothesis_statement: Multi-control intervention framework disentangling boundary seam steps from spatial permutation
measured_evidence: Literature audit confirms prior spatial shortcut studies (Winkler et al. 2019, DeGrave et al. 2021) did not isolate boundary seam edge artifacts from spatial permutation.
scientific_caveat: Contribution is strictly methodological in experimental control design; claims of preregistration or first-ever discovery are unsupported and removed.
